|---|---|---|---|
| **Method** `method` | Median | Median, Gaussian | How Cb and Cr are smoothed. |
| **Median size** `size` | 5 | 3 to 31, odd px | The side of the median window, for the median method. |
| **Gaussian sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 20 px | The standard deviation of the Gaussian, for the Gaussian method. It is cut at 3 sigma. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
